definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頬|ほほ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
{頬|ほほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
{頬|ほほ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}くなった→赤い：00585_akai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頬|ほほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦キス→キス：09763_kisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I kissed her on the cheek.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The cold wind hit my cheeks.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧ and {頬|ほほ} are both standard. ほお is more common today and is the reading in compounds ({頬紅|ほおべに}, ⟦{頬杖|ほおづえ}→頬杖：10678_hoozue⟧, {頬骨|ほおぼね}). In casual speech, especially with children, people say ほっぺ or ⟦ほっぺた→ほっぺた：21486_hoppeta⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to puff out one's cheeks (sulking)
- ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: (food) so delicious one's cheeks might fall off; also ⟦ほっぺた→ほっぺた：21486_hoppeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧
- ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to blush

COMPOUNDS:
- {頬紅|ほおべに}: blusher, rouge
- ⟦{頬杖|ほおづえ}をつく→頬杖をつく：22823_hoozuewotsuku⟧: to rest one's cheek on one's hand
- {頬骨|ほおぼね}: cheekbone
- ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧ずり: rubbing cheeks together (affection)

WATCH OUT:
ほほえむ (to smile) is written ⟦{微笑|ほほえ}む→微笑む：02416_hohoemu⟧, not with {頬|ほほ}.
